name: veylcore-ui
description: Build workspace for VeylCore NUI apps. Compiled output is committed into each resource's web/dist.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @veyl/lib-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/target-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/inventory-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/shop-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/bank-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/hud-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/appearance-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/vehicle-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/drugs-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/phone-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/apartments-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/doorlocks-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/cityhall-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/management-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/emotes-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/medical-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/dispatch-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @veyl/lib-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/target-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/inventory-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/shop-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/bank-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/hud-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/appearance-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/vehicle-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/drugs-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/phone-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/apartments-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/doorlocks-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/cityhall-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/management-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/emotes-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/medical-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/dispatch-ui
